What we take on,
and what we send elsewhere
A short menu is an honesty policy. If your matter belongs with a specialist we know, we say so at the first meeting and make the introduction ourselves.
From incorporation to the sale of the company, with every financing in between. We act for companies that intend to exist in thirty years.

The entire arc of working life: offers, equity, exits, and the conversations in between, kept dignified on both sides of the desk.
Every exit is a future reference check. We draft accordingly.
— Handbooks and equity plans humans can read
— Non-competes: what they actually mean for you
Wills, trusts, succession and the family conversations that go better with an agenda. Discretion is the entire product.

Plus seven of counsel and associates we are extremely proud of, who work on your matter behind a partner, never instead of one.
